name: Austral-Corbel
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs an orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Around the spatial rift remnant, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
